svg.title: Incidents Caught Live: the path of one incident, from the host to the people who act on it, in one image
svg.text: Watched 24/7, even when no test runs.
Incidents open on their own, then reach the people who act.
Before this: Your devices, watched 24/7. One freeze up close: Freeze: menu or stuck video?
An incident opens, with its picture
A black screen, a freeze or no sound that lasted 30 seconds
No test, no script to write
Automatic triage: harmless ones are discarded
Many alarms are harmless, like a menu left open
A screen judged harmless is remembered: next time, no AI call.
Only the kept alerts are sent
To an email address or a webhook of yours
A false alarm never reaches you.
People act on the Incidents page
Your Discard or Keep teaches the triage that screen.
